overall: Atlanta is off to a warm, humid start this morning with the running max already at 82.9°F by 08:52 ET, up from 80.6°F at 06:52 — a gain of 2.3°F in two hours. With roughly 6–7 hours of heating potential remaining, conditions are on track for a hot June day in Atlanta.
